name: kxfeddecision
title: What will the Federal Reserve decide on the federal funds target rate at the next FOMC meeting?
settlement: Resolves to the outcome matching the change in the upper bound of the federal funds target range announced at the scheduled FOMC meeting: hike of more than 25bps, hike of 25bps, maintain, cut of 25bps, or cut of more than 25bps. Outcomes are mutually exclusive; if the scheduled meeting is canceled, 'Fed maintains rate' resolves Yes.
decideContext: Estimate how the news shifts the probability of each FOMC rate-decision outcome (large hike, 25bp hike, hold, 25bp cut, large cut) at the next scheduled meeting. The market resolves on the Fed's official announced change to the target rate at that meeting.
